SELECT ts.seq, to_char(cast(ts.created_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as createdAt, to_char(cast(ts.created_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp) + CAST(ts.days||' DAYS' AS INTERVAL), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as afterAt, ts.days FROM track_service ts
ts.is_enabled AND ts.status = 'ACTIVE' and CAST (ts.created_at as date) + CAST (ts.days AS INTEGER) <= current_date
